title: The Polish poster : from Young Poland through the Second World War : holdings in the Prints and Photographs Division, Library of Congress
historicalContext: [NEEDS REVIEW] "A project completed with the support and cooperation of the European Division." Describes 136 Polish posters from the period 1900-1945. Includes bibliographical references (p. 97-104). Also available in digital form on the Library of Congress Web site.
